title: Identification of DNA damage response and crotonylation-related biomarkers for lung adenocarcinoma via machine learning and WGCNA.
summary: WGCNA and three machine-learning feature-selection methods applied to LUAD transcriptomes from GSE27262 and GSE140797 yielded candidate DNA-damage-response/crotonylation hub genes; cell cytotoxicity assays provided follow-up checks. These are hypothesis-generating candidates, not demonstrated clinical biomarkers.
